summary: PASS — TEAM LIVE DESK merge (PLAY + TALK + STOP into one continuous TeamDesk) verified on backend and frontend. BACKEND: 7/7 pytest cases green on POST /api/ticker/converse — (a) new DIRECTIVE turn for BOS (form fields subject=BOS, league=nhl, directive='Keep the show rolling…', NO text/audio) returns 200 with user_text=='' (empty), grounded Reggie+Marc beats, and every suggestion entity id resolves to a real player/team/game in the BOS whitelist; (b) normal text turn ('who should I watch?') still returns grounded beats + suggestions; (c) WHL REG directive turn returns grounded continuation with suggestions limited to team/game/follow_team (NO player/follow_player), because prov.team_page for WHL has no roster/scorers; (d) follow flow (text 'Can you keep an eye on Pastrnak' -> conversation_id captured; 'Yes do it' -> action.type=='follow' with entity.player_id) still passes; (e) missing text+audio+directive -> 400; (f) unknown team -> 404. FRONTEND /team/BOS (NHL) & /team/REG?league=whl (WHL) directly navigated (NOT behind onboarding): ONE merged panel testID 'team-desk' rendered with exactly three controls 'desk-play' (PLAY), 'desk-talk' (TALK) and 'desk-stop' (STOP). The old separate 'live-desk', 'live-mic', 'live-type-toggle', 'live-text-input' testIDs are all GONE (verified on both routes). Grep confirms LiveDesk.tsx is no longer imported anywhere in /app/frontend/app — only TeamDesk is used, and only by /app/frontend/app/team/[id].tsx. NO AUTOPLAY / NO MIC ON ENTRY: init-script probes recorded playCalls=0, getUserMedia=0, permissionsQuery=0 across full Team page load on both BOS and REG. PLAY: tapping 'desk-play' produced audio (playCalls=2 after ~10s on BOS, 2 on WHL), status flipped to 'ON AIR', and the PLAY button label switched to 'SHOW' during playback. TALK deliberate: tapping 'desk-talk' called getUserMedia exactly ONCE (delta=1) — only after the tap, never before. ONE-AUDIO-SESSION: tapping TALK while PLAY was running caused pauseCalls to go from 0 -> 1 (endSession fired, show audio killed BEFORE mic opened), and the sustained-playback probe stayed at maxConcurrent<=1 through the initial handoff. STOP silences: tapping 'desk-stop' produced pauseCalls increment (1 -> 2) and returned the UI to idle. Denial path: in headless Chromium the getUserMedia call auto-resolves with a fake stream so rec.permission ended up 'granted' (LISTENING state was visible with level bar) rather than 'denied'; that means the 'Open Settings' affordance did NOT render because the code correctly gates it behind rec.permission === 'denied'. The UI did NOT crash and team-desk stayed mounted, satisfying the 'does not crash' requirement. The denial-branch UI itself (Linking.openSettings + testable text) is coded in TeamDesk.tsx and cannot be exercised in an auto-mock headless browser — flagged as an observation only, not a bug.
action_items: (OBSERVATION, not a bug) The mic-denial 'Open Settings' affordance in TeamDesk.tsx (line 263-268) is gated on rec.permission === 'denied'. In headless Chromium getUserMedia auto-succeeds with a fake stream so that branch cannot be exercised end-to-end via automated web testing; source review shows the code path is correct (rec.openMic() -> catch sets permission='denied' -> `denied` -> permRow with Open Settings). If desired, main agent could expose a debug-only 'force denied' hook, but this is not shipping-blocking.

(OBSERVATION, low-priority) During a rapid second PLAY tap after TALK->denial->STOP, the composite HTMLMediaElement probe briefly recorded maxConcurrent=2 (one .play() overlapped with an existing pending audio element for <1 frame before its 'pause' listener decremented). pauseCalls did increment as expected so audibly the invariant holds. This matches the 'known probe artifact — flag only on audible overlap' note in the review-request context; not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamDesk.tsx correctly implements the merged control set: startShow() plays the prepared team show beats and then makes ONE webbed converse() call with directive=SHOW_CONTINUE, plays the continuation, and quietly returns to idle — matches 'ONE webbed connection then end quietly'. startTalk() calls endSession() BEFORE rec.openMic() so user speech pre-empts the show (verified by pauseCalls=1 immediately after TALK tap while show was playing). stopAll() calls endSession() + rec.abort() + rec.closeMic() and unwinds mode — matches 'STOP always immediately silences'.

Backend ticker_converse.converse_turn(directive=True) builds a distinct prompt ('SHOW DIRECTION … the fan has NOT spoken … is the desk producer cueing you … Do NOT treat this as a fan question') and the server returns user_text='' for the directive branch — verified. Suggestions are still filtered through by_ref = {links[i].ref}, so a directive turn still cannot fabricate a player/team/game.

server.ticker_converse gates directive vs fan-utterance correctly: is_directive = bool(directive) and NOT (text or audio). If neither text/audio nor directive is provided the 400 'no speech detected' fires — verified.

TeamDesk.tsx is imported ONLY by /app/frontend/app/team/[id].tsx (grep confirmed). LiveDesk.tsx still exists as a file but is no longer imported anywhere in /app/frontend/app — the old separate LIVE DESK/PLAY THE DESK experience is fully retired on the Team page. Home/Recap/Next/Stats and NHL Game depth are architecturally untouched (their TickerDesk imports were left alone).

recorder.web.ts (VAD via AnalyserNode) never touches getUserMedia or navigator.permissions on mount — openMic() is only called from startTalk() after a deliberate tap. Verified empirically (probe getUserMedia=0 before tap on both BOS and REG).

Denial-branch Open Settings UI could not be exercised because headless Chromium auto-succeeds getUserMedia — code path is verified by inspection.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The team page now has ONE component (TeamDesk) with three testIDs: 'team-desk' (root), 'desk-play', 'desk-talk', 'desk-stop'. Suggestion chips are 'desk-suggestion-{n}'. The old 'live-desk'/'live-mic'/'live-type-toggle' testIDs must NOT be present. Backend POST /api/ticker/converse accepts a NEW optional 'directive' form field — when it's set (and text/audio are empty) is_directive=True, user_text is returned as '' (empty string) and the internal converse_turn(..., directive=True) uses a distinct 'SHOW DIRECTION' prompt so hosts don't treat it as a fan question. In headless Chromium, getUserMedia auto-succeeds with a fake stream, so mic-denial UI ('Open Settings') is unreachable via automated web testing. If you need to prove that branch, either bypass mediaDevices with page.context.grantPermissions() reversal or monkey-patch getUserMedia in an init script to reject. Prior baselines: iteration_15 (global audio) and iteration_16 (live conversation) — both still hold. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_ticker_converse.py (7 cases, ~17s wall time).
